title: Lunchline letter rise
description: A heading split into letters that rise into place through their word's mask: the first letter starts just below its place, each next one further down, so a line settles like a wave from left to right. Scrubbed with the scroll as the heading enters (scroll mode), or once on load (load mode, 22ms apart, with a fade).
notes: takes plain text (it splits on spaces, then into letters); screen readers get the whole text from aria-label
CSS only: without scroll-driven animations, or with reduced motion, the text simply stands
use load mode only for a heading in the first screen
name: lunchline-letter-rise

props.name: text
props.description: the text; split into words (each its own mask) and letters

props.name: as
props.description: the element to render: h2 by default

props.name: mode
props.description:
"scroll": the letters rise as the heading scrolls into view, scrubbed with the scroll;
"load": they rise once when the page loads (for the first screen)

props.name: delay
props.description: load mode only: wait this long (ms) before the first letter moves

props.name: drop
props.description:
how far the first letter starts below its place, in em; each next letter starts 15%
further down, up to `maxDrop`

props.name: maxDrop
props.description: the furthest any letter starts below its place, in em (about one line hides it fully)

props.name: className
props.description: size, leading, weight and colour go here
